title: LEB verification result (one entry of `probes` in the mechanical report)
description: Backward compatible. The legacy form is {id, corrigida, msg}. The new form adds `result` and `proves`. Evidence from a structural verifier may only prove R3 (a ceiling) or C3; it never proves R1, R2, R4, C1, C2, C4 or C5.

corrigida.description: legacy boolean; decides C3 for Template C only

unobserved.description: properties of the flaw this verifier cannot observe; copied into the report as NOT VERIFIED
